tagline.en: The busiest freeway in Maryland, and the hardest to widen
tagline.zh: 马里兰州最繁忙的高速，也是最难拓宽的一条

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-495, the Capital Beltway, at Bethesda
start.zh: 贝塞斯达，与首都环线 I-495 相接

end.zh: 弗雷德里克，与 I-70 相接

en: I-270 runs north-west from the Capital Beltway at Bethesda through Rockville, Gaithersburg and Germantown to I-70 at Frederick. It is the spine of Montgomery County's biotechnology corridor, and the reason the road matters more than its 34.7 miles suggest: the jobs are strung along it, and so is the commute. At the southern end it splits into an east and a west spur to meet the Beltway at two separate points.

It carries more traffic than any other freeway in Maryland. State highway counts for 2016 put the section between Montrose Road and MD 189 at 257,000 vehicles a day — the highest freeway volume in the state, ahead of every section of the Capital Beltway. The even hundreds digit suggests a loop, and although I-270 does not curve back on itself, both of its ends are on other Interstates, which is the effect the numbering is reaching for.
zh: I-270 自贝塞斯达的首都环线向西北，经罗克维尔、盖瑟斯堡与杰曼敦，抵达弗雷德里克的 I-70。它是蒙哥马利县生物技术走廊的脊梁，这也是它的重要性远超 34.7 英里所示的原因：工作岗位沿它排布，通勤车流也是。在南端，它分出东、西两条支线，分别在两处接上环线。
它的交通量高于马里兰州任何其他高速公路。州公路局 2016 年的统计显示，蒙特罗斯路与 MD 189 之间的路段每日 257,000 辆——为全州高速最高值，超过首都环线的任何一段。偶数百位暗示这是环线，尽管 I-270 并不折回自身，但它两端都接在别的州际公路上，而这正是这套编号规则想达到的效果。

en: The road was built between 1953 and 1960 as the Washington National Pike, carrying US 240 between Bethesda and Frederick, and became I-70S when the Interstate system was created. There were plans to carry it on past the Beltway into Washington on the North Central Freeway; residents in the path stopped that in the 1970s. The US 240 designation came off in 1972, and on 18 May 1975 I-70S became I-270.

Congestion in Montgomery County led to a $200 million widening between I-495 and MD 118, finished on 12 October 1990, which took some sections from six lanes to twelve and pulled still more development up the corridor; HOV lanes were added on 19 December 1996. By 1999 traffic had already reached the levels forecast for 2010. What to do next has been contested for a decade. Maryland spent $100 million on an innovative congestion management contract announced in 2017, then pursued a $7.3 billion public-private toll-lane scheme, which Governor Wes Moore abandoned in favour of a roughly $4 billion publicly financed plan that rebuilds the American Legion Bridge first and leaves the I-270 corridor sections to a later phase.
zh: 这条路于 1953 至 1960 年间建成，名为「华盛顿国家大道」，承载贝塞斯达至弗雷德里克之间的 US 240；州际系统设立后，它成为 I-70S。当初还计划让它越过环线、沿「中北高速」进入华盛顿特区，沿线居民在 1970 年代阻止了这一方案。US 240 编号于 1972 年撤除，1975 年 5 月 18 日，I-70S 改为 I-270。

蒙哥马利县的拥堵促成了 I-495 与 MD 118 之间一项 2 亿美元的拓宽工程，1990 年 10 月 12 日完工，部分路段由六车道拓至十二车道，也把更多开发引向走廊上游；1996 年 12 月 19 日增设合乘车道。到 1999 年，交通量已达到原本预测 2010 年才会出现的水平。此后该怎么办，争论了十年。马里兰州在 2017 年宣布了一项 1 亿美元的创新拥堵管理合同，随后推动一项 73 亿美元的公私合营收费车道方案；韦斯·摩尔州长放弃了该方案，转而采用约 40 亿美元的公共融资计划——先重建美国军团大桥，把 I-270 走廊各段留待后期。

timeline.en: The Washington National Pike is complete between Bethesda and Frederick.
